modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: These allowances apply on Link's Saab 340B Plus and Metro 23 aircraft, on all fares.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: 1 piece of cabin baggage for adults and children, max 48(L) x 34 (H) x 23 (D) cm. Infants have no cabin baggage allowance.

carryon_weight.value: Maximum cabin baggage weight 7kg for adults and children.

extra_items.value: In addition you may carry a handbag or purse, an overcoat or blanket, an umbrella or walking stick, a small camera or binoculars, reading matter, or crutches or a prosthetic device you depend on.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: The free checked allowance on Link's Saab 340B Plus and Metro 23 aircraft depends on the fare.

allowance_by_fare.value: Flexible and Freedom fares: 1 piece (maximum 23kg). Standard and Deal fares: 1 piece (maximum 15kg). Same for adults and children; infants have no allowance but may check 3 infant items (maximum 23kg total) free.

size_weight.value: Each piece must not exceed 140cm total (length + width + height); no single item may exceed 32kg.

excess_fees.value: Excess baggage: $ 33.00 for each extra piece. Overweight: $5.50 per kilogram over the allowance per piece. Amounts are Australian dollars including GST.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

within_control.value: If a Link flight is cancelled, misses your destination or makes you miss a confirmed connection on your ticket for reasons within its control, Link will, at its discretion, carry you on its next service with space or re-route you; if neither is suitable, it gives a credit for a replacement flight within 12 months of ticket issue, or a refund on request if no acceptable replacement can be offered in that period.

beyond_control.value: For delays or cancellations caused by events beyond its control, Link uses reasonable endeavours to rebook you on its next available flight at no extra cost, or gives a flight credit to the value of your ticket, valid for 12 months from the original ticket's issue date. Other costs are not covered unless required by law.

online_checkin.value: Online check-in opens 24 hours before scheduled departure for bookings made with Link or an Authorised Agent; codeshare passengers, unaccompanied minors and passengers with special needs must check in at the airport. Passengers with checked bags must still visit the counter.

counter_times.value: As a general rule, check-in opens 1 hour before departure and closes 30 minutes before scheduled departure; your itinerary gives the deadline for each flight.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference
